goal: Activate redirecting Phase 1 and Phase 2 demo execution so a new CT can dispatch backend/frontend/android workers with objective acceptance, non-blocking core loop guarantees, and streamlit-safe scope discipline.

inputs.description: Execution session and async contract target.
Latest pre-redirecting blocked checkpoint to supersede.

constraints.notes: No deploy/schema migration/permission elevation/destructive command without explicit user approval. Keep Gap/Entropy disabled for demo mode unless explicitly re-enabled.

acceptance: Kickoff package is trace/task aligned across orchestration/task.json, dispatch, and lane task files.
Phase 1 exit gate is explicit: Focus/Reflection core loop demoable in <=3 minutes and OCR failure does not block completion.
Phase 2 start gate is explicit: enters only after Phase 1 acceptance evidence is published in schema-valid artifacts.
Lane scopes are bounded to redirecting Phase 1/2 demo outcomes and avoid uncontrolled platform expansion.

risk.note: Primary risk is over-engineering under time pressure, causing demo instability and missed Phase 1 completion.

next_actions: Dispatch redirecting phase12 lane prompts to backend/frontend/android workers.
Collect Phase 1 evidence first and publish gate decision artifact before Phase 2 implementation.
Run Phase 2 limited-scope pass (insight/3-tier replay) only after Phase 1 pass.
